title: Concept Design with 3D Facade Visualisation | DUMSKAYA
description: Architectural concept design with 3D visualisation of facades and surroundings: massing, materials and landscaping. Studio in Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Concept design with 3D visualization of building facades and surroundings based on client drawings

blocks.text: Concept design with 3D visualization of building facades and surroundings based on client drawings

parts.html: As part of this project, DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed a unique concept facade design presented in two versions: budget and premium. We also paid special attention to landscaping and the harmonious integration of the house into its surroundings.
For this solution, we used affordable yet high-quality materials, maintaining an aesthetic and modern appearance. Minimalist decor highlights the home’s style, creating a neat and functional facade.

Additionally, we conducted a site analysis to select optimal greenery and pathways made from cost-effective yet durable materials. The landscaping emphasizes the natural beauty of the surroundings while staying within a limited budget.

This version includes elite finishing materials such as natural stone, high-quality plaster, and wooden panels. Exclusive decorative elements add elegance to the facade and highlight the individuality of the house.

The landscape design focuses on premium aesthetics: rare decorative plants, relaxation areas with integrated architectural lighting, and pathways made of noble stone. Every detail harmonizes with the house’s architecture and the surrounding nature.

We ensured that the facade and surrounding area blend naturally with the environment. This makes the house appear as a natural part of the landscape, maintaining a perfect balance between architecture and nature.
Two design options: 3D visualization for both solutions.
Material recommendations: assistance in selecting the optimal choice.
Complete landscaping design: a finished project that enhances the home’s style.
